import importlib.util, json
from pathlib import Path

# Load only the reviewed local module
path = '/inputs/codec.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('codec', path)
codec = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(codec)

x = '%'
once = codec.canonicalize_url(x)
twice = codec.canonicalize_url(once)
print(x, once, twice)
assert once != twice

out = {'input': x, 'once': once, 'twice': twice}
Path('/work/counterexample.json').write_text(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
print('wrote', Path('/work/counterexample.json').read_text())
